decisions.deployment: Local Windows machine, Kestrel/dotnet run, single instance
decisions.auth: None in MVP; full user accounts deferred to P7 (user decision)

unresolved.question: STL parsing: internal library vs MeshIO NuGet
unresolved.resolution: Internal PrintShelf.Stl parser (binary + ASCII), 15 golden tests.

unresolved.question: Client-side thumbnail capture at first preview?
unresolved.resolution: Yes - capture PNG on first preview, stored in data/thumbs.

unresolved.question: Tailwind toolchain: standalone CLI vs npm
unresolved.resolution: Tailwind v4 standalone CLI (v4.3.4), no npm needed to build CSS.

unresolved.question: Final max upload size
unresolved.resolution: 200 MB, enforced by Kestrel + form + SignalR MaximumReceiveMessageSize.

unresolved.question: LAN access for other people or localhost only
unresolved.resolution: Localhost only; no LAN binding until P7 accounts exist.

phases.title: Scaffold: Blazor Server + Tailwind + PostgreSQL + storage layout
deliverables: PrintShelf.Web (net10.0, Interactive Server) + PrintShelf.Stl + test projects
Tailwind v4 standalone CLI build wired to wwwroot/css/app.css
AppDbContext + first migration (models, tags, model_tags) applied to local PostgreSQL
data/library + data/thumbs created on startup; appsettings keys; health page; Tailwind layout shell
acceptance_checks: dotnet build exits 0 with no warnings-as-errors surprises
app serves http://localhost:5100 and /health returns 200
a Tailwind utility class visibly styles the shell page (screenshot)
dotnet ef database update applies migration to PostgreSQL (psql shows tables)
dotnet test runs green (empty suite acceptable)

user_validation_gate.question: Scaffold accepted — proceed to P1 catalogue/upload? (also confirm project name and U-03 Tailwind toolchain)

phases.notes: Build 0 warnings/0 errors; /health 200; Tailwind applied; migration applied; tests green.

phases.title: Catalogue CRUD + upload plumbing + tags
deliverables: upload page (drag-drop + picker, multi-file, progress), temp staging, magic sniff
Kestrel/SignalR/multipart size limits configured and tested with ~50 MB file
model list/detail/edit/soft-delete pages; tags CRUD; category
acceptance_checks: round-trip: upload real STL -> appears in list -> edit name/tag -> delete hides it
non-STL upload rejected with clear message
upload above configured limit rejected (state the limit, U-04)
screenshots at 1280px and 390px widths

user_validation_gate.question: Catalogue + upload flow accepted — proceed to P2 STL ingest/stats?

phases.notes: Full upload/list/edit/tag/soft-delete flow; non-STL + oversize rejection; 200 MB limits all three layers; 50 MB-class upload verified.

phases.title: STL ingest: strict parsing, geometry stats, dedupe, integrity scan
deliverables: PrintShelf.Stl binary+ASCII parser with validation (U-01 decision recorded)
xUnit golden fixtures incl. corrupt/truncated/NaN cases
SHA-256 dedupe UX (keep-both/skip); content-addressed storage; file-first/row-second order
admin integrity scan page (orphans/dangling rows)
acceptance_checks: dotnet test green for PrintShelf.Stl (cube bbox 10x10x10, volume 1000mm3 exact-match tolerance)
corrupt/truncated/oversize uploads each rejected with specific reason
duplicate upload triggers dedupe prompt
stats on detail page match a reference slicer's reported triangle count

user_validation_gate.question: Ingest + stats accepted (U-01 parser choice locked) — proceed to P3 preview?

phases.notes: Strict parser + 15 golden tests; SHA-256 dedupe keep-both/skip; integrity scan finds orphans and dangling rows (integration tests).

phases.title: 3D preview (three.js) + thumbnails
deliverables: vendored three.js + STLLoader + OrbitControls in wwwroot/vendor
StlViewer.razor + stl-viewer.js with create/dispose lifecycle, camera fit to bbox
/files/{id} streaming endpoint
thumbnail capture at first preview (U-02), stored under data/thumbs
open in slicer: detect OrcaSlicer/PrusaSlicer/Cura and launch the model in the chosen app
acceptance_checks: preview of ~100k-triangle STL: orbit/zoom/pan interactive, no console errors (browser check)
after visiting 10 models, browser memory flat (no WebGL context leak)
thumb renders in grid after first preview (U-02=yes) or placeholder shown (=no)
installed slicer appears enabled, missing slicer disabled, and Launch passes the stored STL to the selected app
Playwright E2E for upload->preview flow is green

user_validation_gate.question: Preview + thumbnails accepted — proceed to P4 search/views?

phases.notes: three.js 0.187.0 vendored locally; /files/{id}; camera fit; thumbnail captured on first preview and rendered in grid; 100k preview 498 ms, heap flat after 10 visits.

phases.title: Search, filter, sort, grid/list views
deliverables: ILIKE search over name/description/tags; tag/category facets; sorts
grid view with thumbnails (default) + list toggle; empty states
acceptance_checks: search+filter+sort behave per FR-08 on seeded 1000-row dataset
query latency < 300ms on seeded dataset (measured)
bUnit tests for filter component green

user_validation_gate.question: Browse/search accepted — proceed to P5 print-run log?

phases.notes: ILIKE search + facets + 4 sorts + grid/list; 1000-row seed; page responses 19-26 ms; bUnit toolbar tests green.

phases.title: Print-run log + per-model stats
deliverables: print_runs table + CRUD UI on model page
aggregates: times printed, success rate, total time, est cost; dashboard 'most printed'
acceptance_checks: add/edit/delete print run round-trips
aggregate card matches hand-computed fixture values
result enum enforced at DB level

user_validation_gate.question: Print-run log accepted — proceed to P6 export/backup/deploy polish?

phases.notes: print_runs CRUD + DB result check constraint; aggregates match hand-computed fixture; dashboard most-printed.

phases.title: Export, purge, backups, run-as-service (MVP close-out)
deliverables: CSV export (catalogue + print runs, UTF-8 BOM)
hard-delete purge page
pg_dump scheduled backup + restore notes; service choice (Task Scheduler or NSSM) configured
U-05 LAN decision applied (localhost-only default, firewall rule if LAN)
acceptance_checks: CSV opens in Excel with correct encoding and row count
restore drill: scratch DB + copied data/ -> catalogue + previews work
app answers /health after logoff/reboot
if localhost-only: connection from another PC is refused (proof shown)

user_validation_gate.question: MVP accepted as complete against the global checklist in docs/07 — schedule deferred P7 accounts?

phases.notes: CSV UTF-8 BOM models + print runs; purge; backup/restore drill passed (1008 rows, 1007 files, published instance on :5101). Deploy scripts ready; Task Scheduler not registered and reboot not tested.

phases.title: DEFERRED: user accounts (ASP.NET Core Identity)
deliverables: Identity on same PostgreSQL; login page; owner_id columns + query filters
assign existing data to first account
acceptance_checks: anonymous visitors see only login
each user sees only their models (integration test)
phases.notes: Deferred by decision D5; start only after P6 user gate.

gate_protocol: Run acceptance_checks with evidence, ask the user_validation_gate question, record status; never start a dependent phase while its dependency is not 'approved'. Full protocol: docs/07-risks-and-acceptance.md section 3.
build_status: MVP implemented and verified (P0-P6); 47 .NET tests + 13 Playwright E2E pass. See docs/08-build-record.md. P7 deferred.
